item.title: Acknowledgement
item.content:encoded:
Both artworks were Public Domain borrowed from these websites:

https://www.wikiart.org/en/odilon-redon/everywhere-eyeballs-are-aflame-1888

https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Redon_-_Was_ist_der_Sinn.jpeg

This is a GOI Format from the Group-of-Interest The Reliquary from the Lusophone Branch, an organization similar to museums and galleries. They collect objects both for selling or display or sometimes for their own use just like the item featured here.

Thought that maybe I should include this:

Bathala was the Chief God of the Philippine Mythology. His brother in the article, Hindi-Mapangalanan, is a fictional deity that I created just for this page.
